about: Hold-out cases from repository history that are not in the 25-case ledger. The cases, their sources and the first-run predictions were written after the scanner rules were frozen (git tag rules-frozen) and before the first run. After a review of that first run, each case also got a frozen fixture, a detection predicate and a trigger check, so that a case is only counted when its bug is shown to be exercised. detect: findings the rules must produce on the case's tool, matched on tool, variant, outcome and operation and never on wording. trigger: the observable behaviour that shows the bug is exercised, taken from the pull request text. Result: caught = triggered, detected at the buggy commit, absent at the fix. missed = triggered but not caught. not_exercised = the trigger was not seen, so the case counts neither way. The sources are not stored here: tools/holdout_sources.sh fetches them from the public repository into a scratch folder.

cases.quote: The MCP formatters still dereferenced the removed fields (usage.plan.name ... voiceMinutes)
cases.expect: a crash, error result or undefined in the text on the spec-built /v1/usage response
cases.why: the contract is a documented response shape, the class the rules were built for

cases.quote: body was z.string() (required) despite its own description saying it may be empty when sending media only
cases.expect: none: the rules have no check for an input the tool refuses but the API accepts

trigger.note: the tool refuses a send that has media and no body

cases.quote: list_calls rejects status/direction/search combined with a number_id or agent_id scope (those scoped endpoints don't support them)
cases.expect: none: the tool drops the filters silently, nothing wrong is sent or returned

trigger.note: the fix refuses a scoped call that also carries a filter, where the buggy tool dropped the filter silently

excluded.why: send_message recipient validation and typed voice fields: the commit uses zod 3 and an older layout, so the scanner cannot load it
